citations.claim: energy just before bounce is near initial, within tolerance
first energy_bound violation at step 91 exceeds allowed 198.686
outgoing speed after bounce amplified ~58% instead of damped to ~9.17 with e=0.5

counterfactual.change: raised initial y from 1.9 to 5.0 so no floor collision occurs within 91 steps; same dt/gravity/e/m/r/steps - removes energy injection

explanation: Floor bounce at step 90->91 injects energy: incoming speed ~18.34 (energy ~176 J) rebounds to ~28.96 (energy ~427 J) despite e=0.5 (should reduce) and even e=0 still gains energy (176->203 J). Gravity work is near-zero over 0.06s, no controller work, so gain violates 10%+5J tolerance. Counterfactual raising initial height to avoid ground contact in 91 steps removes violation, proving bounce is causal. Likely impulse + positional correction error on arena floor (y=0) amplifies normal velocity instead of damping.
vision_note: The blue body is near the bottom boundary (floor) in frames 88-90 and is in contact with/at the floor in the violating frame 91. No large positional jump, tunneling through the wall, or obvious high bounce is visible across the stills — the ball appears to remain essentially at the floor line between 90 and 91.
